rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: The Check Point Avanan integration enables AI assistants to interact with the Avanan Harmony Email and Collaboration platform. It provides security event management capabilities and supports multi-tenant MSP operations. Built by WYRE Technology in TypeScript with Docker support, the server has 5 releases through v2.1.0 in April 2026 and follows conventional commit-based automation.
